title: Executable edge
description: Fair odds against what this venue will actually fill at, after fees. Positive edge on a side means the venue is underpricing it.

probability.label: Fair odds of Up
probability.description: The modelled chance the round settles Up, as a percentage. The yardstick the edges are measured from.

edge_up.label: Edge on Up
edge_up.description: Fair odds minus the price you can buy Up at right now, in cents. Positive means Up is cheap on this venue.

edge_down.label: Edge on Down
edge_down.description: Fair odds of Down minus the price you can buy Down at right now, in cents. Positive means Down is cheap on this venue.

executable_up_price.label: Up fills at
executable_up_price.description: The price a buy of Up would actually fill at on this venue, fees included. What the edge is measured against.

executable_down_price.label: Down fills at
executable_down_price.description: The price a buy of Down would actually fill at on this venue, fees included. What the edge is measured against.
